description: The last building on this side before the ground gives up and goes to grass, and the only one on Foundry Way with any glass to speak of: a long low span of it, about a third replaced with mismatched panes and a few panels of bare board where the glass lost. Bags of compost stacked against the end wall under a tarpaulin. A hand-painted board reads COMPOST MENTIS, and under it, EVERYTHING HERE WILL GROW IN THIS SOIL, WE HAVE CHECKED.
name: Compost Mentis
